C-INFRA-CI-NATIVE-FIXTURES-BOOTSTRAP-202.Summary: Explicitly build external native test helper binaries (reference-native-provider, test-violator) prior to cross-package integration test execution in repository-owned CI suites.
C-INFRA-CI-NATIVE-FIXTURES-BOOTSTRAP-202.Problem: Isolated CI runners executing cross-package integration tests (worldline-reference-external) in clean job environments fail to locate native child process binaries (reference-native-provider, test-violator) because cargo test for one crate does not implicitly build bin targets of another crate.

Goals.Goal: Add explicit repository-owned step to build worldline-native-host binary targets prior to running suites requiring native child process fixtures.
Ensure local and hosted CI jobs execute identical commands without duplicating build logic in workflow YAML.
Pass all four CI suites (Source, Correctness, ArchitectureSecurity, ProvingSlice) on fresh clean environments.

Constraints.Constraint: Repository-owned CI runner Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1 owns the build invocation for external native test fixtures.
GitHub Actions workflow files remain thin orchestration invoking Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1 suites.
No green by skipping: all native provider, violator, and S1 proving tests remain strict required gates.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Hardcoding platform-specific paths or binary locations outside Cargo's target profile directory.
Modifying capability broker authorization or plugin runtime contracts.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Invoke-WorldlineCi.ps1 builds worldline-native-host binary targets in Correctness, ArchitectureSecurity, and ProvingSlice suites before invoking tests that spawn child processes.
ArchitectureSecurity and ProvingSlice suites pass on clean target environments without relying on prior workspace test runs.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: All suites build native helper fixtures explicitly and pass protocol robustness, cross-mode conformance, and external S1 proving tests.

Assumptions.Assumption: Cargo output directory follows standard target/debug layout on host runner.
